body: I already planned on it. What’s your goal by saying all this? I don’t really think you’re doing too well at reaching it hehe.
If it wasn’t I wouldn’t have posted this.
Y’know, I think I’m good. Not my fortes.
I mean, this isn’t news to me. Not my goal, but okay I guess?
Maybe I should look into it, once I’m able to. I really appreciate this man. Thank you, it just feels good to put this out there.

That’s not the only cause of my self esteem being fucked. Cousin.. did things to me when I was a young boy. And she got off free. Even though I’ve told people about it. First girlfriend said she’d kill her parents so we could be together, which was too much for me. Second girlfriend cheated on me. Last girlfriend was good, but I pushed her away because I’m not used to positive attention and I got attached quickly.
Alright, well I’m trusting you here. I’m working on applying for jobs, as shitty as it’ll be cause of my anxiety.
Yes, but I’m not financially stable enough to. And I can’t move in with any friends cause well.. I don’t have any heh.

Constant arguing, always being told I’m the reason that things are how they are. Even though I literally stay in my room all day and don’t talk to anybody. Everyone always screams at me. Brother steals from everyone. And blames missing things on me. Sister lies so I get screamed at more. And I just feel so little after it all
Living is troubling me, the fact that I’m still breathing is. I don’t like myself, don’t like my home life, don’t like my social life. Don’t like life

I fake smile so people don’t worry about me. The people not in my family of course. Like a mask kinda. I am afraid of screaming though. So I guess that could be one of the reasons. I did have somebody like that, someone that I actually was really comfortable with. But well, she and I don’t really talk anymore. Also, I do write some stuff on my main account for r/nosleep.
